rows.name: Matteo Tittarelli

validation.title_observed: Landing Page Conversion Rates - 40 Statistics Every Marketing Leader Should Know in 2026
validation.notes: The article attributes individual statistics to Unbounce, MarketingProfs, First Page Sage, Ruler Analytics, and other named sources. Primary-source validation is still required before citing any statistic as evidence.

primary_source_review.observed_basis: Unbounce reports Q4 2024 internal data from 41,000 landing pages, 464 million visitors, and 57 million conversions.
primary_source_review.use: Potential citation for the exact Unbounce benchmark with its stated population and definition.
primary_source_review.restriction: Do not generalize this benchmark to Nebula buyers or claim causal effects.

primary_source_review.observed_basis: MarketingProfs republishes Unbounce findings and identifies Unbounce as the research source.
primary_source_review.restriction: Do not count this as an independent dataset from Unbounce.

primary_source_review.observed_basis: Ruler reports 2026 data from 110 million plus sessions, 5 million plus conversions, and tracked spend across 13 industries.
primary_source_review.use: Potential comparison source if definitions, date, industry categories, and conversion scope are documented.
primary_source_review.restriction: Do not combine its averages with Unbounce medians or treat the datasets as interchangeable.

primary_source_review.observed_basis: Backlinko republishes statistics attributed to Unbounce, GetResponse, HubSpot, Gartner, and other sources.
primary_source_review.use: Discovery source for tracing claims to originals.
primary_source_review.restriction: Not independent corroboration for the statistics it compiles.

rows.supported_nebula_topic: landing page conversion benchmarks and diagnostic context
rows.proposed_action: Build a claim-to-primary-source map. Use only claims whose original methodology and population can be inspected. Do not copy benchmark numbers into buyer-facing copy yet.
rows.outreach_action: Draft a value-first note offering original, provenance-backed audit observations or a methodology discussion. Do not send without review.
rows.success_signal: Published citation or qualified reply attributable to corr-20260905-001

decision_rules: A publisher record is not customer proof.
A compiled benchmark article does not independently corroborate every statistic it repeats.
No Nebula claim is promoted solely because a scout found a publisher.
No outreach is sent from this register without a separate approval event.
The missing two scout rows must be recovered or revalidated before the batch is marked complete.

proves: one publicly accessible publisher article exists and identifies its author and date
the article cites multiple external benchmark sources
one candidate exists for primary-source mapping and possible value-first outreach
does_not_prove: the reported benchmark values are accurate
the benchmarks apply to Nebula's buyers
the publisher will respond or publish anything
